DApp-named investing/lending/staking → use `okx-dapp-discovery`"},{"id":"F0:L0020","text":"- For DeFi positions / holdings → use `okx-defi-portfolio`"},{"id":"F0:L0021","text":"- For token price/chart support-chains` | Get supported chains for DeFi |"},{"id":"F0:L0033","text":"| 2 | `defi support-platforms` | Get supported platforms for DeFi |"},{"id":"F0:L0034","text":"| 3 | `defi list` | List top |"},{"id":"F0:L0049","text":"|-------------|-------------|"},{"id":"F0:L0050","text":"| `SINGLE_EARN` | Single-token yield (savings, staking, vaults) |"},{"id":"F0:L0051","text":"| `DEX_POOL` | Liquidity pools (Uniswap V2/V3, PancakeSwap, etc.) |"},{"id":"F0:L0052","text":"| `LENDING` | Lending / borrowing (Aave, Compound, etc.) |"},{"id":"F0:L0053","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0054","text":"## Chain Support"},{"id":"F0:L0055","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0056","text":"CLI resolves chain names automatically (e.g. `ethereum` → `1`, `bsc` → `56`, `solana` → `501`)."},{"id":"F0:L0057","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0058","text":"## Operation Flow"},{"id":"F0:L0059","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0060","text":"### Step 0: Address Resolution"},{"id":"F0:L0061","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0062","text":"When the user does NOT provide a wallet address, resolve it automatically from the Agentic Wallet **before** running any defi command:"},{"id":"F0:L0063","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0064","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0065","text":"1. onchainos wallet status          → check if logged in, get active account"},{"id":"F0:L0066","text":"2. onchainos wallet addresses       → get addresses grouped by chain category:"},{"id":"F0:L0067","text":"                                       - XLayer addresses"},{"id":"F0:L0068","text":"                                       - EVM addresses (Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, etc.)"},{"id":"F0:L0069","text":"                                       - Solana addresses"},{"id":"F0:L0070","text":"3. Match address to target chain:"},{"id":"F0:L0071","text":"   - EVM chains → use EVM address"},{"id":"F0:L0072","text":"   - Solana     → use Solana address"},{"id":"F0:L0073","text":"   - XLayer     → use XLayer address"},{"id":"F0:L0074","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0075","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0076","text":"Rules:"},{"id":"F0:L0077","text":"- If the user provides an explicit address, use it directly — skip this step"},{"id":"F0:L0078","text":"- If wallet is not logged in, ask the user to log in first (→ `okx-agentic-wallet`) or provide an address manually"},{"id":"F0:L0079","text":"- If the user says \"check all accounts\" or \"all wallets\", use `wallet balance --all` to get all account IDs, then `wallet switch <id>` + `wallet addresses` for each account"},{"id":"F0:L0080","text":"- Always confirm the resolved address with the user before proceeding if the account has multiple addresses of the same type"},{"id":"F0:L0081","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0082","text":"### Deposit (invest)"},{"id":"F0:L0083","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0084","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0085","text":"1. defi search --token USDC --chain ethereum       → pick investmentId"},{"id":"F0:L0086","text":"2. defi detail --investment-id <id>                 → confirm APY/TVL, get underlyingToken[].tokenAddress"},{"id":"F0:L0087","text":"3. token search --query <tokenAddress> --chains <chain>  → get decimal (e.g. 6) for amount conversion"},{"id":"F0:L0088","text":"4. Ask user for amount → convert: userAmount × 10^decimal (e.g. 100 USDC → 100000000)"},{"id":"F0:L0089","text":"5. Check wallet balance (okx-agentic-wallet) → if insufficient, warn user and stop"},{"id":"F0:L0090","text":"6. defi invest --investment-id <id> --address <addr> --token USDC --amount 100000000"},{"id":"F0:L0091","text":"   → CLI returns calldata (APPROVE + DEPOSIT steps)"},{"id":"F0:L0092","text":"7. User signs and broadcasts each step in order"},{"id":"F0:L0093","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0094","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0095","text":"> **Token decimal**: Get `tokenAddress` from `defi detail` → `underlyingToken[].tokenAddress`, then use `token search --query <tokenAddress>` to get `decimal`. Same approach as DEX swap."},{"id":"F0:L0096","text":">"},{"id":"F0:L0097","text":"> **CRITICAL — Balance check is REQUIRED before calling `defi invest`.** You MUST call `okx-agentic-wallet` to verify the user has sufficient balance of the deposit token BEFORE generating calldata. If balance is insufficient, STOP and warn the user. Do NOT proceed to `defi invest` without confirming balance. Skipping this step wastes gas and results in failed on-chain transactions."},{"id":"F0:L0098","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0099","text":"### Withdraw"},{"id":"F0:L0100","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0101","text":"> **CRITICAL — position-detail is MANDATORY before withdraw.** You MUST call `defi position-detail` immediately before every `defi withdraw`, even if you already have position data from a previous call. Do NOT reuse stale position-detail results."},{"id":"F0:L0102","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0103","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0104","text":"1. defi positions --address <addr> --chains ethereum"},{"id":"F0:L0105","text":"2. defi position-detail --address <addr> --chain ethereum --platform-id <pid>"},{"id":"F0:L0106","text":"   → MUST be called fresh — get investmentId, tokenPrecision, coinAmount (current balance)"},{"id":"F0:L0107","text":"3. Full exit:"},{"id":"F0:L0108","text":"   defi withdraw --investment-id <id> --address <addr> --chain ethereum --ratio 1 --platform-id <pid>"},{"id":"F0:L0109","text":"   Partial exit (convert coinAmount to minimal units: amount × 10^tokenPrecision):"},{"id":"F0:L0110","text":"   defi withdraw --investment-id <id> --address <addr> --chain ethereum --amount <minimal_units> --platform-id <pid>"},{"id":"F0:L0111","text":"4. User signs and broadcasts"},{"id":"F0:L0112","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0113","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0114","text":"> **Partial exit --amount**: position-detail returns `coinAmount` in human-readable (e.g. \"2.3792\") and `tokenPrecision` (e.g. 6). Convert to minimal units: `floor(2.3792 × 10^6) = 2379200` → `--amount 2379200`."},{"id":"F0:L0115","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0116","text":"### Claim Rewards"},{"id":"F0:L0117","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0118","text":"> **CRITICAL — position-detail is MANDATORY before collect.** You MUST call `defi position-detail` immediately before every `defi collect`, even if you already have position data from a previous call in the conversation. Position data (rewards, investmentId, platformId, tokenId) changes after each on-chain operation (withdraw, previous collect, etc.), so stale data leads to wrong parameters or failed transactions. Do NOT skip this step. Do NOT reuse position-detail results from earlier in the conversation."},{"id":"F0:L0119","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0120","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0121","text":"1. defi positions --address <addr> --chains ethereum"},{"id":"F0:L0122","text":"2. defi position-detail --address <addr> --chain ethereum --platform-id <pid>"},{"id":"F0:L0123","text":"   → MUST be called fresh — do NOT reuse prior results"},{"id":"F0:L0124","text":"3. defi collect --address <addr> --chain ethereum --reward-type REWARD_INVESTMENT --investment-id <id> --platform-id <pid>"},{"id":"F0:L0125","text":"   → CLI returns calldata (or skips if no rewards)"},{"id":"F0:L0126","text":"4. User signs and broadcasts"},{"id":"F0:L0127","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0128","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0129","text":"### V3 Pool Deposit"},{"id":"F0:L0130","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0131","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0132","text":"1. defi search --token USDT --platform PancakeSwap --chain bsc --product-group DEX_POOL"},{"id":"F0:L0133","text":"2. defi detail --investment-id <id>"},{"id":"F0:L0134","text":"3. (Optional) defi depth-price-chart --investment-id <id>"},{"id":"F0:L0135","text":"   → show liquidity depth distribution to help user pick tick range"},{"id":"F0:L0136","text":"4. Ask user for amount and tick range"},{"id":"F0:L0137","text":"5. Check wallet balance (okx-agentic-wallet) → if insufficient, warn user and stop"},{"id":"F0:L0138","text":"6. defi invest --investment-id <id> --address <addr> --token USDT --amount 100000000 --range 5"},{"id":"F0:L0139","text":"   → CLI handles calculate-entry internally, returns calldata"},{"id":"F0:L0140","text":"7. User signs and broadcasts"},{"id":"F0:L0141","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0142","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0143","text":"### View Chart Data"},{"id":"F0:L0144","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0145","text":"Use chart commands to analyze product trends before investing or to monitor existing positions."},{"id":"F0:L0146","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0147","text":"**APY History** — check yield trend before depositing:"},{"id":"F0:L0148","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0149","text":"defi rate-chart --investment-id <id> --time-range MONTH"},{"id":"F0:L0150","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0151","text":"- Time ranges: `WEEK` (default), `MONTH`, `SEASON` (3 months), `YEAR`. `DAY` is V3 Pool only."},{"id":"F0:L0152","text":"- Returns: `timestamp`, `rate` (APY), `bonusRate` (extra rewards), `limitValue` (1=peak, -1=trough)."},{"id":"F0:L0153","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0154","text":"**TVL History** — evaluate pool size stability:"},{"id":"F0:L0155","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0156","text":"defi tvl-chart --investment-id <id> --time-range SEASON"},{"id":"F0:L0157","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0158","text":"- Time ranges: same as rate-chart."},{"id":"F0:L0159","text":"- Returns: `chartVos[]` with `timestamp`, `tvl` (USD), `limitValue`."},{"id":"F0:L0160","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0161","text":"**V3 Depth Chart** — see liquidity concentration to pick optimal tick range:"},{"id":"F0:L0162","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0163","text":"defi depth-price-chart --investment-id <id>"},{"id":"F0:L0164","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0165","text":"- Returns: `tick`, `liquidity`, `liquidityNet`, `token0Price`, `token1Price` per tick."},{"id":"F0:L0166","text":"- No `--time-range` parameter — DEPTH mode always returns current snapshot."},{"id":"F0:L0167","text":"- Use this before V3 Pool deposit to identify where liquidity is concentrated and choose `tickLower`/`tickUpper` accordingly."},{"id":"F0:L0168","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0169","text":"**V3 Price History** — see historical relative price between token0 and token1:"},{"id":"F0:L0170","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0171","text":"defi depth-price-chart --investment-id <id> --chart-type PRICE --time-range WEEK"},{"id":"F0:L0172","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0173","text":"- Chart types: `DEPTH` (default), `PRICE`."},{"id":"F0:L0174","text":"- `--time-range` only applies to PRICE mode: `DAY` (default), `WEEK`."},{"id":"F0:L0175","text":"- Returns: `token0Price`, `token1Price`, `timestamp` per data point."},{"id":"F0:L0176","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0177","text":"### Step 3: Sign & Broadcast Calldata"},{"id":"F0:L0178","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0179","text":"After `invest`/`withdraw`/`collect` returns `dataList`, execute each step via one of two paths:"},{"id":"F0:L0180","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0181","text":"**Path A (user-provided wallet)**: user signs externally → broadcast via gateway"},{"id":"F0:L0182","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F0:L0183","text":"# For each dataList step:"},{"id":"F0:L0184","text":"# 1. User signs the tx externally using dataList[N].to, dataList[N].serializedData, dataList[N].value"},{"id":"F0:L0185","text":"# 2. Broadcast:"},{"id":"F0:L0186","text":"onchainos gateway broadcast --signed-tx <signed_hex> --address <addr> --chain <chain>"},{"id":"F0:L0187","text":"# 3. Poll until confirmed:"},{"id":"F0:L0188","text":"onchainos gateway orders --address <addr> --chain <chain> --order-id <orderId>"},{"id":"F0:L0189","text":"# → wait for txStatus=2, then proceed to next step"},{"id":"F0:L0190","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0191","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0192","text":"**Path B (Agentic Wallet)**: sign & broadcast via `wallet contract-call`"},{"id":"F0:L0193","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0194","text":"EVM chains (Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, etc.):"},{"id":"F0:L0195","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F0:L0196","text":"onchainos wallet contract-call \\"},{"id":"F0:L0197","text":"  --to <dataList[N].to> \\"},{"id":"F0:L0198","text":"  --chain <chainIndex> \\"},{"id":"F0:L0199","text":"  --input-data <dataList[N].serializedData> \\"},{"id":"F0:L0200","text":"  --value <value_in_UI_units> \\"},{"id":"F0:L0201","text":"  --biz-type defi"},{"id":"F0:L0202","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0203","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0204","text":"EVM (XLayer):"},{"id":"F0:L0205","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F0:L0206","text":"onchainos wallet contract-call \\"},{"id":"F0:L0207","text":"  --to <dataList[N].to> \\"},{"id":"F0:L0208","text":"  --chain 196 \\"},{"id":"F0:L0209","text":"  --input-data <dataList[N].serializedData> \\"},{"id":"F0:L0210","text":"  --value <value_in_UI_units> \\"},{"id":"F0:L0211","text":"  --biz-type defi"},{"id":"F0:L0212","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0213","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0214","text":"Solana:"},{"id":"F0:L0215","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F0:L0216","text":"onchainos wallet contract-call \\"},{"id":"F0:L0217","text":"  --to <dataList[N].to> \\"},{"id":"F0:L0218","text":"  --chain 501 \\"},{"id":"F0:L0219","text":"  --unsigned-tx <dataList[N].serializedData> \\"},{"id":"F0:L0220","text":"  --biz-type defi"},{"id":"F0:L0221","text":"```"},{"id":"F0:L0222","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0223","text":"`contract-call` handles TEE signing and broadcasting internally — no separate broadcast step needed."},{"id":"F0:L0224","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0225","text":"**`--value` unit conversion**: `dataList[].value` is in minimal units (wei). `contract-call --value` expects UI units. Convert: `value_UI = value / 10^nativeToken.decimal` (e.g. 18 for ETH/POL, 9 for SOL). If `value` is `\"\"`, `\"0\"`, or `\"0x0\"`, use `\"0\"`."},{"id":"F0:L0226","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0227","text":"**`--chain` mapping**: `contract-call` and `gateway broadcast` require `realChainIndex` (e.g. `1`=Ethereum, `137`=Polygon, `56`=BSC, `501`=Solana, `196`=XLayer)."},{"id":"F0:L0228","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0229","text":"**Execution rules**:"},{"id":"F0:L0230","text":"- Execute `dataList[0]` first, then `dataList[1]`, etc. Never in parallel."},{"id":"F0:L0231","text":"- Wait for on-chain confirmation before next step (Path A: `txStatus=2`; Path B: `contract-call` returns txHash)."},{"id":"F0:L0232","text":"- If any step fails, stop all remaining steps and report which succeeded/failed."},{"id":"F0:L0233","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0234","text":"> `invest`/`withdraw`/`collect` only return **unsigned calldata** — they do NOT broadcast. The CLI never holds private keys."},{"id":"F0:L0235","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0236","text":"## Displaying Search / List Results"},{"id":"F0:L0237","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0238","text":"| # | Platform | Chain | investmentId | Name | APY | TVL |"},{"id":"F0:L0239","text":"|---|---------|-------|-------------|------|-----|-----|"},{"id":"F0:L0240","text":"| 1 | Aave V3 | ETH | 9502 | USDC | 1.89% | $3.52B |"},{"id":"F0:L0241","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0242","text":"- `investmentId` is **MANDATORY** in every row"},{"id":"F0:L0243","text":"- `rate` is decimal → multiply by 100 and append `%`"},{"id":"F0:L0244","text":"- `tvl` → format as human-readable USD ($3.52B, $537M)"},{"id":"F0:L0245","text":"- Display data as-is — do NOT editorialize on APY values"},{"id":"F0:L0246","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0247","text":"## rewardType Reference"},{"id":"F0:L0248","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0249","text":"| rewardType | When to use | Required params |"},{"id":"F0:L0250","text":"|------------|-------------|-----------------|"},{"id":"F0:L0251","text":"| `REWARD_PLATFORM` | Protocol-level rewards (e.g. AAVE token) | `--platform-id` |"},{"id":"F0:L0252","text":"| `REWARD_INVESTMENT` | Product mining/staking rewards | `--investment-id` + `--platform-id` |"},{"id":"F0:L0253","text":"| `V3_FEE` | V3 trading fee collection | `--investment-id` + `--token-id` |"},{"id":"F0:L0254","text":"| `REWARD_OKX_BONUS` | OKX bonus rewards | `--investment-id` + `--platform-id` |"},{"id":"F0:L0255","text":"| `REWARD_MERKLE_BONUS` | Merkle proof-based bonus | `--investment-id` + `--platform-id` |"},{"id":"F0:L0256","text":"| `UNLOCKED_PRINCIPAL` | Unlocked principal after lock | `--investment-id` + `--principal-index` |"},{"id":"F0:L0257","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0258","text":"## Key Protocol Rules"},{"id":"F0:L0259","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0260","text":"- **Aave borrow**: uses `callDataType=WITHDRAW` internally — do not expose to user"},{"id":"F0:L0261","text":"- **Aave repay**: uses `callDataType=DEPOSIT` internally — do not expose to user"},{"id":"F0:L0262","text":"- **V3 Pool exit**: pass `--token-id` + `--ratio` (e.g. `--ratio 1` for full exit)"},{"id":"F0:L0263","text":"- **Partial withdrawal (non-V3)**: pass `--amount` for the exit amount"},{"id":"F0:L0264","text":"- **Full withdrawal**: `--ratio 1`"},{"id":"F0:L0265","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0266","text":"## Post-execution Suggestions"},{"id":"F0:L0267","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0268","text":"| Just completed | Suggest |"},{"id":"F0:L0269","text":"|----------------|---------|"},{"id":"F0:L0270","text":"| `defi list` / `defi search` | View details → `defi detail`, or start deposit flow |"},{"id":"F0:L0271","text":"| `defi detail` | Check trends → `defi rate-chart` / `defi tvl-chart`, or proceed → `defi invest` |"},{"id":"F0:L0272","text":"| `defi detail` (V3 Pool) | View depth → `defi depth-price-chart`, check price history → `defi depth-price-chart --chart-type PRICE` |"},{"id":"F0:L0273","text":"| `defi invest` success | View positions → `okx-defi-portfolio`, or search more |"},{"id":"F0:L0274","text":"| `defi withdraw` success | Check positions → `okx-defi-portfolio`, or check balance → `okx-agentic-wallet` |"},{"id":"F0:L0275","text":"| `defi collect` success | Check positions → `okx-defi-portfolio`, or swap rewards → `okx-agentic-wallet` |"},{"id":"F0:L0276","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0277","text":"## Error Codes"},{"id":"F0:L0278","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0279","text":"| Code | Scenario | Handling |"},{"id":"F0:L0280","text":"|------|----------|----------|"},{"id":"F0:L0281","text":"| 84400 | Parameter null | Check required params — partial exit needs `--amount` or `--ratio` |"},{"id":"F0:L0282","text":"| 84021 | Asset syncing | \"Position data is syncing, please retry shortly\" |"},{"id":"F0:L0283","text":"| 84023 | Invalid expectOutputList | CLI auto-constructs from position-detail; retry or pass `--platform-id` |"},{"id":"F0:L0284","text":"| 84014 | Balance check failed | Insufficient balance — check with `okx-agentic-wallet` |"},{"id":"F0:L0285","text":"| 84018 | Balancing failed | V3 balancing failed — adjust price range or increase slippage |"},{"id":"F0:L0286","text":"| 84010 | Token not supported | Check supported tokens via `defi detail` |"},{"id":"F0:L0287","text":"| 84001 | Platform not supported | DeFi platform not supported |"},{"id":"F0:L0288","text":"| 84016 | Contract execution failed | Check parameters and retry |"},{"id":"F0:L0289","text":"| 84019 | Address format mismatch | Address format invalid for this chain |"},{"id":"F0:L0290","text":"| 50011 | Rate limit | Wait and retry |"},{"id":"F0:L0291","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0292","text":"## Global Notes"},{"id":"F0:L0293","text":""},{"id":"F0:L0294","text":"- `--amount` must be in **minimal units** (integer). Convert: userAmount × 10^tokenPrecision. Example: 0.1 USDC (precision=6) → `--amount 100000`. Get tokenPrecision from `defi detail` or `defi position-detail`"},{"id":"F0:L0295","text":"- The wallet address parameter for ALL defi commands is `--address`"},{"id":"F0:L0296","text":"- `--slippage` default is `\"0.01\"` (1%); suggest `\"0.03\"`–`\"0.05\"` for volatile V3 pools"},{"id":"F0:L0297","text":"- **CRITICAL — Solana transaction expiry**: Solana DeFi transactions use base58-encoded VersionedTransaction with a blockhash that expires in ~60 seconds. After receiving calldata, you MUST warn the user: \"This Solana transaction must be signed and broadcast within 60 seconds or it will expire. Please sign immediately.\" Do NOT proceed to other conversation without delivering this warning first."},{"id":"F0:L0298","text":"- **CRITICAL — High APY risk warning**: When displaying search/list results, if any product has APY > 50% (rate > 0.5), you MUST warn the user: \"WARNING: This product shows APY above 50%, which indicates elevated risk (potential impermanent loss, smart contract risk, or unsustainable rewards). Proceed with caution.\" Do NOT silently display high-APY products without this warning."},{"id":"F0:L0299","text":"- **CRITICAL — Address-chain compatibility**: When calling `defi positions` or `defi position-detail`, the `--address` and chain parameters must be compatible. EVM addresses (`0x…`) can only query EVM chains; Solana addresses (base58) can only query `solana`. Never mix them — the API will return error 84019 (Address format error)."},{"id":"F0:L0300","text":"  - `0x…` address → only pass EVM chains: `ethereum,bsc,polygon,arbitrum,base,xlayer,avalanche,optimism,fantom,linea,scroll,zksync`"},{"id":"F0:L0301","text":"  - base58 address → only pass `solana`"},{"id":"F0:L0302","text":"  - If the user wants positions across both EVM and Solana, make **two separate calls** with the respective addresses"},{"id":"F0:L0303","text":"- User confirmation required before every invest/withdraw/collect execution"},{"id":"F0:L0304","text":"- Address used for calldata generation MUST match the signing address"}],"source_sha256":"615d9dc0dc54a87a519cf364bd88bdbcb61894cf7e970b57adf008c3f5f9b63a"},{"file":"references/cli-reference.md","file_id":"F1","lines":[{"id":"F1:L0001","text":"# OKX DeFi — CLI commands."},{"id":"F1:L0004","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0005","text":"## 1. onchainos defi support-chains"},{"id":"F1:L0006","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0007","text":"Get all chains currently supported by DeFi support-chains"},{"id":"F1:L0011","text":"```"},{"id":"F1:L0012","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0013","text":"No parameters."},{"id":"F1:L0014","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0015","text":"**Return fields** {\"chainIndex\": \"1\", \"network\": \"ETH\"},"},{"id":"F1:L0027","text":"  {\"chainIndex\": \"56\", \"network\": \"BSC\"},"},{"id":"F1:L0028","text":"  {\"chainIndex\": \"137\", \"network\": \"POLYGON\"},"},{"id":"F1:L0029","text":"  {\"chainIndex\": \"42161\", \"network\": \"ARBITRUM\"},"},{"id":"F1:L0030","text":"  {\"chainIndex\": \"8453\", \"network\": \"BASE\"}"},{"id":"F1:L0031","text":"]"},{"id":"F1:L0032","text":"```"},{"id":"F1:L0033","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0034","text":"---"},{"id":"F1:L0035","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0036","text":"## 2. onchainos defi support-platforms"},{"id":"F1:L0037","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0038","text":"Get all DeFi platforms and their product counts."},{"id":"F1:L0039","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0040","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F1:L0041","text":"onchainos defi support-platforms"},{"id":"F1:L0042","text":"```"},{"id":"F1:L0043","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0044","text":"No parameters."},{"id":"F1:L0045","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0046","text":"**Return fields** (array):"},{"id":"F1:L0047","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0048","text":"| Field | Type | Description |"},{"id":"F1:L0049","text":"|---|---|---|"},{"id":"F1:L0050","text":"| `analysisPlatformId` | String | list"},{"id":"F1:L0067","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0068","text":"List all DeFi products by APY (no filters, paginated)."},{"id":"F1:L0069","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0070","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F1:L0071","text":"onchainos defi list [--page-num <n>]"},{"id":"F1:L0072","text":"```"},{"id":"F1:L0073","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0074","text":"| Param | Required | Default | Description |"},{"id":"F1:L0075","text":"|---|---|---|---|"},{"id":"F1:L0076","text":"| `--page-num` | No | 1 | Page number (page size fixed at 20) |"},{"id":"F1:L0077","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0078","text":"> Internally calls the same API as `defi search` with no filters. Returns products sorted by APY descending."},{"id":"F1:L0079","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0080","text":"**Return fields**: Same as `defi search` (see below)."},{"id":"F1:L0081","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0082","text":"---"},{"id":"F1:L0083","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0084","text":"## 4. onchainos defi search"},{"id":"F1:L0085","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0086","text":"Search DeFi products across chains (earn, pools, lending)."},{"id":"F1:L0087","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0088","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F1:L0089","text":"onchainos defi search --token <tokens> [--platform <names>] [--chain <chain>] [--product-group <group>] [--page-num <n>]"},{"id":"F1:L0090","text":"```"},{"id":"F1:L0091","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0092","text":"| Param | Required | Default | Description |"},{"id":"F1:L0093","text":"|---|---|---|---|"},{"id":"F1:L0094","text":"| `--token` | No* | — | Comma-separated token keywords (e.g. `\"USDC,ETH\"`) |"},{"id":"F1:L0095","text":"| `--platform` | No* | — | Comma-separated platform keywords (e.g. `\"Aave,Compound\"`) |"},{"id":"F1:L0096","text":"| `--chain` | No | — | Chain name (e.g. `ethereum`, `bsc`, `solana`) |"},{"id":"F1:L0097","text":"| `--product-group` | No | `SINGLE_EARN` | Product group filter (see table below) |"},{"id":"F1:L0098","text":"| `--page-num` | No | 1 | Page number (page size fixed at 20) |"},{"id":"F1:L0099","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0100","text":"**`--product-group` values**:"},{"id":"F1:L0101","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0102","text":"| Value | Description |"},{"id":"F1:L0103","text":"|---|---|"},{"id":"F1:L0104","text":"| `SINGLE_EARN` | Single token earn (savings, staking, vaults) |"},{"id":"F1:L0105","text":"| `DEX_POOL` | DEX liquidity pools (V2/V3 LP) |"},{"id":"F1:L0106","text":"| `LENDING` | Lending protocols (supply & borrow) |"},{"id":"F1:L0107","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0108","text":"> \\* At least one of `--token` or `--platform` is **required**. CLI will error if both are omitted."},{"id":"F1:L0109","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0110","text":"**Return fields** (`data` object):"},{"id":"F1:L0111","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0112","text":"| Field | Type | Description |"},{"id":"F1:L0113","text":"|---|---|---|"},{"id":"F1:L0114","text":"| `total` | Integer | Total number of matching products |"},{"id":"F1:L0115","text":"| `list[].investmentId` | Long | Product ID — used in `detail`, `prepare`, `deposit` |"},{"id":"F1:L0116","text":"| `list[].name` | String | Product name |"},{"id":"F1:L0117","text":"| `list[].platformName` | String | Protocol name (e.g. `\"Aave V3\"`, `\"Compound V3\"`) |"},{"id":"F1:L0118","text":"| `list[].rate` | String | APY as decimal (e.g. `\"0.01820\"` = 1.82%) |"},{"id":"F1:L0119","text":"| `list[].tvl` | String | Total Value Locked in USD |"},{"id":"F1:L0120","text":"| `list[].chainIndex` | String | Chain identifier |"},{"id":"F1:L0121","text":"| `list[].feeRate` | String | Protocol fee rate (nullable) |"},{"id":"F1:L0122","text":"| `list[].detailPath` | String | Detail page path (nullable) |"},{"id":"F1:L0123","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0124","text":"---"},{"id":"F1:L0125","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0126","text":"## 5. onchainos defi detail"},{"id":"F1:L0127","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0128","text":"Get full product details and live APY."},{"id":"F1:L0129","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0130","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F1:L0131","text":"onchainos |"},{"id":"F1:L0137","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0138","text":"**Return fields** (per API doc):"},{"id":"F1:L0139","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0140","text":"| Field | Type | Description name (e.g. \"Ethereum\") |"},{"id":"F1:L0149","text":"| `rate` | String | APY as decimal (e.g. `\"0.01820\"` = 1.82%) |"},{"id":"F1:L0150","text":"| `tvl` | String | Total Value Locked in USD actions.reason: Example invest command generates deposit calldata, including approval and deposit steps; the CLI's actual network or file effect is not specified here.
Withdraw example invokes position-based withdrawal calldata generation; it does not itself broadcast the transaction.
Collect example generates reward-claim calldata, or skips when no rewards; broadcasting is a separate step.
Shows broadcasting a signed transaction through the gateway and polling its order; target endpoint is not specified.
Example calls the Agentic Wallet contract-call with DeFi transaction data; text says it signs and broadcasts, but does not specify the underlying transport.
Solana example submits unsigned transaction data through wallet contract-call; the chain is specified, but the underlying effect mechanism is not.
